# `m.forex.conversion`

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

An amount converted between two currencies at the latest quote.

```python
m.forex.conversion(from_currency, to_currency, *, amount=1.0, precision=2)
```

[All datasets](README.md)

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Methods | `fetch()`, `poll()` |
| Served by | REST |
| `poll()` | `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`: holds exactly the latest cycle's rows, keyed by `Symbol`; `mode=dm.PollMode.APPEND` also keys by `LastTimestamp` |

## Arguments

What each argument does for this dataset, and the rule it follows for every dataset that takes it.

| Argument | For this dataset | For every dataset |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `from_currency` | The currency to convert from, as three upper-case letters, such as `"AUD"`. |  |
| `to_currency` | The currency to convert to, such as `"USD"`. |  |
| `amount` | The amount to convert, positive and finite; 1.0 by default. |  |
| `precision` | The decimal places of the result, 0 to 4; 2 by default. |  |

## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `symbol`: "The symbol pair that was evaluated from the request." | REST |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. | REST |
| `Converted` | double | The result of the conversion. | REST |
| `From` | String | The "from" currency symbol. | REST |
| `InitialAmount` | double | The amount to convert. | REST |
| `LastBid` | double | The bid price. From the `last` object: Contains the requested quote data for the specified forex currency pair. | REST |
| `LastAsk` | double | The ask price. From the `last` object: Contains the requested quote data for the specified forex currency pair. | REST |
| `LastExchange` | long | The exchange ID. See Exchanges (https://massive.com/docs/rest/forex/market-operations/exchanges) for Massive's mapping of exchange IDs. From the `last` object: Contains the requested quote data for the specified forex currency pair. | REST |
| `LastTimestamp` | Instant | The Unix millisecond timestamp. From the `last` object: Contains the requested quote data for the specified forex currency pair. | REST |
| `To` | String | The "to" currency symbol. | REST |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST |
